'''Blatberry pie''' was a type of small [[Pie/Legends|pie]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]].<ref name="Band" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> Ortolan [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] kept several blatberry pies hidden behind his [[Nalargon/Legends|organ]], which he played in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] and was subsequently revealed to be the famous Human [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]], Rebo noticed that she was skinny and looked malnourished. After a long party at the palace, in an attempt to fatten her up, Rebo took one of his blatberry pies and gave it to Organa, who thanked him.<ref name="Band" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blatberry pies appeared in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," a short story written by [[John Gregory Betancourt]] and published in the ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' story collection in [[1995]].<ref name="Band" />
